custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 5 on hand.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425699 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425699-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create a vendor return for this test, return A, for part A to any vendor, saved and not completed.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then Create Return; pick any vendor under Vendor, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425699-A in Part Number and pick it, type 1 in Quantity, then click Save Return.
  • Create a vendor return for this test, return B, for part A to any vendor, completed (accepted by the vendor).
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then Create Return; pick any vendor under Vendor, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425699-A in Part Number and pick it, type 1 in Quantity, then click Save Return. Then, on the Returns list, tick that return's row, click Receive Credit, type any Credit Memo Number, pick a Credit Date and click Post Credit.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
